aboutBio: I am Alex Negara, a software engineer from Chisinau, Moldova. I have been building automations and web tools for small businesses since 2024 — first as a web developer at a logistics company, then as an automation developer at Zotaris, where I built warranty processing systems that replaced hours of manual work with workflows that run in minutes. I also taught frontend and backend technologies at the Technical University of Moldova. Today I work independently, helping small teams automate repetitive processes and build websites that actually convert visitors into clients.
faq1Q: How long does a typical project take?
faq1A: Landing pages: 5–10 days. Automations: 3–14 days depending on integrations. Web apps: 2–4 weeks. I give you an exact timeline before we start.
faq2Q: What if I am not happy with the result?
faq2A: You see progress throughout, not just at the end. If something is not right, we adjust during the build — not after. I have never had a client ask for a full redo.
faq3Q: Do you offer support after delivery?
faq3A: Yes. Every project includes 7 days of free support for bugs and questions. After that, I am available for maintenance or new features at agreed rates.
faq4Q: What do I need to prepare before starting?
faq4A: Just your idea and access to existing tools if relevant (domain, hosting, n8n instance). I handle the rest and guide you through setup.
